quotes_not_found: Efficacy outcomes included the following self-report scales: the Depression Anxiety and Stress Scale,9 a 42–item scale that assesses three negative emotional states of tension/stress, anxiety and depression over the past week; the Jefferson Scale of Physician Empathy -Student Version,10 a 20-item questionnaire assessing health care professional empathy in patient care settings; The Five Facets of Mindfulness Questionnaire (FFMQ),11 a 39-item questionnaire exploring mindfulness in daily life; the Self-Compassion Scale (SCS),12 a 26-item self-report scale that captures how respondents perceive their actions toward themselves in difficult times; and the Adapted Altruism Scale,13 a 14-item scale that assesses altruistic behaviors.
